info.title: Solar Generation API
info.description:
Solar generation API for Sri Lanka. Paths use the configured API prefix.

### Authentication and access
Use a user/admin bearer JWT for protected reads, an active installation's device JWT for reading submission, and an admin JWT for installation management. Access follows the user's current role and jurisdiction: national users/admins read nationally, provincial users within their province, and district users within their district. District users may navigate their parent province without seeing sibling districts. Inactive installations and their history remain readable. Access checks apply to data, counts and conditional responses. Tokens use HS256 with configured issuer, audience and expiry; no refresh tokens are issued.

### Requests and pagination
Only documented query parameters are accepted; unknown or repeated parameters are rejected. Operations without query parameters accept none. JSON bodies reject undeclared fields. Paginated counts cover all authorized matches; links preserve filters, sorting and page size. Offsets beyond the result set return an empty page with the matching count.

### Caching
Protected GETs use private, no-cache and strong ETags. Authorization and rate limits apply even to conditional requests. If-None-Match takes precedence over If-Modified-Since. Only individual/latest readings provide Last-Modified; other protected reads ignore If-Modified-Since alone. Token exchanges, writes, health and errors use no-store. Errors expose no cache validators or private diagnostics. Admin If-Match comparisons are atomic with the mutation.

### Rate limits
Protected reads share 120 requests/minute per user. User and device logins each allow 5 attempts/15 minutes per IP and account email or meter ID. Reading submissions allow 30/minute per installation and IP. Admin creation, status updates and deletion share 30/minute per admin. Public specification, Swagger page and assets share 60/minute per IP. Invalid bodies/queries do not consume login or write budgets; valid attempts, duplicates, conflicts, stale preconditions, no-op updates and conditional requests count. Limit enforcement failures reject the request. Rate-limit errors include Retry-After in seconds.

patch.description: Activate or deactivate an installation as an admin, preserving identity, credentials and history. Repeating the current status leaves the representation and ETag unchanged. Deactivation blocks device login and ingestion, including unexpired tokens. Reactivation restores the same credentials and previously issued tokens only until their original expiry.

parameters.name: installationId
parameters.description: Public UUID v4.

parameters.name: If-Match
parameters.description: Optional installation-detail ETag, quoted tag list or sole *. At least one strong tag must match; weak tags never match. Omission allows an unconditional write.

200.description: Requested active/inactive status applied, or already set; public representation and resulting strong ETag. No Last-Modified.

400.description: Invalid public installation UUID, body other than exactly one status field with active or inactive, malformed If-Match (INVALID_REQUEST), or malformed JSON (INVALID_JSON).

412.description: If-Match does not match the current installation ETag (PRECONDITION_FAILED); unchanged, including a no-op status update.

delete.description: As an admin, delete an active or inactive installation only when it has no readings. No related records are deleted. Concurrent ingestion cannot leave orphan readings. Deleted-installation tokens become invalid; registering the same meter again creates a new installation UUID.

parameters.name: installationId

parameters.name: If-Match
parameters.description: Optional installation-detail ETag, quoted tag list or sole *. At least one strong tag must match; weak tags never match. Omission allows an unconditional write.

204.description: Installation deleted; no body, Content-Type or resource validators. An empty request needs no Content-Type.

400.description: Invalid installation UUID, any request body, malformed If-Match (INVALID_REQUEST), or malformed JSON (INVALID_JSON). Any request body, including non-JSON or streamed content, is rejected.

409.description: Installation has one or more readings (INSTALLATION_HAS_READINGS); installation and all history retained. Evaluated after If-Match.

412.description: If-Match does not match the current installation ETag (PRECONDITION_FAILED); unchanged. Evaluated before the reading-history conflict, so a stale precondition takes precedence.

get.description: Summarize power and observed daily energy at one captured asOf time. Current power includes only active installations whose latest reading at or before asOf is within 30 minutes, inclusive; other active installations count as stale. Inactive installations contribute energy but no power or freshness counts. Daily energy sums nonnegative consecutive counter differences from Asia/Colombo midnight through asOf, inclusive. Use an exact midnight baseline if available, otherwise the first daily sample. Skip counter decreases and resume from the lower counter. Each installation is counted incomplete once for a missing midnight baseline, fewer than two daily readings or any decrease. No pre-midnight baseline, interpolation, extrapolation or estimation is used; observed energy may be incomplete. Empty districts return zero totals. Validators can change with displayed asOf, freshness expiry or midnight without new readings.

userId.description: Authenticated public UUID from the stored principal; equals the JWT sub claim.

asOf.description: Once-captured request time displayed in Asia/Colombo as DD Mon YYYY, hh:mm AM/PM (Sri Lanka). Calculations retain full millisecond precision; display is minute precision.

freshInstallationCount.description: Active installations with a latest eligible reading within 30 minutes inclusive.

staleInstallationCount.description: Other active installations, including those without readings at or before asOf.

currentPowerKw.description: Sum of latest fresh active-installation powerKw.

todayEnergyKwh.description: Observed daily energy that may be incomplete. Sum nonnegative consecutive cumulative-counter differences from local midnight through asOf; no estimation or interpolation. Includes inactive history.

incompleteEnergyInstallationCount.description: Active or inactive installations with missing midnight baseline, fewer than two daily readings, or counter decreases; each installation counted once.

meterId.description: Non-whitespace string; trimmed before storage. Unique across active and inactive installations.

deviceSecret.description: Non-whitespace secret; exact characters preserved for shared salted scrypt hashing. Never returned.

UserBearer.description: User/admin JWT from /auth/user-tokens; access follows the user’s current role and jurisdiction.

InstallationBearer.description: Device JWT from /auth/device-tokens; requires installation-write scope and ownership of the active installation.

LoginRetryAfter.description: Seconds until the exceeded counter window expires.

ScopedETag.description: Strong validator of the complete response and current user jurisdiction; collections include the parent, filters and pagination.

ReadingETag.description: Strong validator of the exact public reading JSON, identical to its POST validator.

ReadingLastModified.description: HTTP date derived from server receivedAt, at whole-second resolution.

InstallationETag.description: Strong validator of public installation fields (id, substationId, meterId, status), shared by GET, POST and PATCH and usable with If-Match. Unaffected by reader identity, readings, geography names or private metadata.
